caption.en: Three proposals for "no public data stores" — and why only a resource control states the invariant.
caption.es: Tres propuestas para "ningún almacén de datos público", y por qué solo un control sobre el recurso expresa la invariante.

note.en: Reversibility decides prevention vs detection. Detection is fine for everything you can undo.
note.es: La reversibilidad decide entre prevención y detección. Detectar basta para todo lo que puedes revertir.

note.en: Not either/or. The scanner is the second layer, covering what the policy can't express.
note.es: No es uno u otro. El escáner es la segunda capa, cubriendo lo que la política no puede expresar.

note.en: The subtle failure: the policy reviews cleanly, deploys cleanly, and never fires once.
note.es: La falla sutil: la política se revisa bien, se despliega bien y no se activa ni una vez.

note.en: An RCP is a resource-side policy, so it names a principal — that's how it reaches callers outside the org.
note.es: Un RCP es una política del lado del recurso, así que nombra un principal: así alcanza a quien llama desde fuera de la organización.

note.en: Deny + NotAction is a classic inversion bug. Read it out loud before shipping it.
note.es: Deny + NotAction es un error clásico de inversión. Léelo en voz alta antes de desplegarlo.

note.en: Prevention is invisible by design, so it loses budget reviews to detection unless you instrument it.
note.es: La prevención es invisible por diseño, así que pierde revisiones de presupuesto ante la detección si no la instrumentas.

caption.en: The senior engineer's objection, answered with the three things tags provably cannot do.
caption.es: La objeción del ingeniero senior, respondida con las tres cosas que las etiquetas demostrablemente no pueden hacer.

note.en: The whole difference in five words. A tag is enforced by memory; a boundary by the provider.
note.es: Toda la diferencia en cinco palabras: una etiqueta la hace cumplir la memoria; un límite, el proveedor.

note.en: The argument that ends the debate: concrete, verifiable, and untaggable.
note.es: El argumento que cierra el debate: concreto, verificable y no etiquetable.

note.en: Blast radius is decided by the boundary, not by intent expressed in a policy document.
note.es: El radio de impacto lo decide el límite, no la intención expresada en un documento de política.

note.en: Why the objection can't be met with better IAM: these are structural properties, not access rules.
note.es: Por qué la objeción no se resuelve con mejor IAM: son propiedades estructurales, no reglas de acceso.

note.en: The honest cost of a landing zone isn't the accounts — it's the factory and its owner.
note.es: El costo honesto de una landing zone no son las cuentas: es la fábrica y su dueño.

code.snippet:
# ecs-managed-instances.responsibility.yml
# Written as part of the change request that moved the workload — not after.
service: ECS Managed Instances
replaces: ECS on self-managed EC2 + AMI pipeline

provider_absorbs:
  - patching the host OS and container agent
  - AMI build and rollout (the work we are buying our way out of)

we_still_own:
  - the container image and everything in it
  - task-level IAM, secrets, network policy

# The part teams miss: every responsibility the provider takes MOVES something
# we were relying on. Both of these were confirmed before the migration.
seams_that_moved:
  - billing:
      what: >
        The per-instance management fee is charged per second with a one-minute
        minimum, ON TOP of the EC2 charge — and Reservations and Savings Plans do
        not offset that fee.
      published_example: >
        us-west-2 c6a.2xlarge = $0.306/hr EC2 + $0.037/hr fee.
        Only the first number is discountable.
      consequence: >
        Discount coverage % drops even though instance hours did not change and
        nobody deployed anything new. Finance sized the plan for 80% of
        steady-state compute; that number is now wrong for a reason no dashboard
        will explain.
      action: re-price the migration with the undiscountable fee included

  - detection:
      what: ECS Managed Instances are NOT covered by GuardDuty ECS Runtime Monitoring.
      consequence: >
        The signed attestation is now false for exactly the three newest services.
      action: >
        Write the compensating detection into the SAME change request that moved
        the workload, and name the seam explicitly — so the next team that adopts
        this service inherits the finding instead of rediscovering it.

  - debug_access:
      before: SSH to the instance during an incident
      after: no host access; reproduce from logs and exec into the task
      action: the runbook's first step no longer exists — rewrite it

# The fix is NOT to roll back. It is to know both seams and price them.

caption.en: The per-service responsibility line, written down — including the two seams that moved without anyone deploying anything.
caption.es: La línea de responsabilidad por servicio, escrita, incluidas las dos costuras que se movieron sin que nadie desplegara nada.

note.en: The document is part of the change, so the seams are found at review time rather than at month end.
note.es: El documento es parte del cambio, así que las costuras se encuentran en la revisión y no a fin de mes.

note.en: The reframe that makes shared responsibility useful: not two boxes, but a list of what just changed hands.
note.es: El replanteo que hace útil la responsabilidad compartida: no dos cajas, sino una lista de qué acaba de cambiar de manos.

note.en: Discount coverage is one of the two blind spots. Confirm per service; never assume the fee is covered.
note.es: La cobertura del descuento es uno de los dos puntos ciegos. Confirma por servicio; nunca supongas que el cargo está cubierto.

note.en: The published example makes the shape obvious: a ~12% surcharge that no commitment can touch.
note.es: El ejemplo publicado deja clara la forma: un recargo de ~12% que ningún compromiso puede tocar.

note.en: Detection scope is the other blind spot, and the one that silently invalidates an attestation.
note.es: El alcance de detección es el otro punto ciego, y el que invalida una atestación en silencio.

note.en: Writing the seam down is the deliverable. Otherwise each team pays the same discovery cost.
note.es: Escribir la costura es el entregable. Si no, cada equipo paga el mismo costo de descubrimiento.
